local.h: Chicago voters back a permanent festival grounds
local.b: 68% supported a non-binding measure for a Summerfest-style site for music festivals, but there are no clear next steps.
local.title: Chicagoans overwhelmingly support a permanent festival grounds like Milwaukee’s Summerfest. What’s next?

local.h: An inside look at Illinois' newest senator, Juliana Stratton
local.b: The lieutenant governor and proud South Sider will join Sen. Tammy Duckworth, making Illinois the first state with two women of color serving in the Senate at the same time.
local.title: From Kenwood to Washington, an inside look at Illinois’ newest senator, Juliana Stratton

local.h: Illinois House could elect its first woman speaker
local.b: Five women lawmakers are among the names floated to succeed Speaker Emanuel "Chris" Welch, who will not seek a fourth term as speaker.
local.title: Will the Illinois House elect its first woman speaker? Dems float potential contenders to replace Welch

local.h: NJ Gov. Sherrill picks Shirley Emehelu as lieutenant governor
local.b: The former prosecutor and acting secretary of state replaces Dale Caldwell, who resigned in September. Women now hold New Jersey's two highest executive offices for the first time.
local.title: NJ Gov. Sherrill announces her new lieutenant governor pick

local.h: One dead in Hamilton Heights apartment fire
local.b: The fire started in a cluttered third-floor unit of a Riverside Drive building around 1:30 a.m. Five others, including two firefighters, were hurt. FDNY says 87 people have died in fires this year, up from 45 at this point last year.
local.title: 1 dead after early morning fire rips through Hamilton Heights apartment building, FDNY says

local.h: NYC expands Code Blue cold-weather help for homeless New Yorkers
local.b: The city is adding $25 million, 300 more outreach workers and 800 more beds for nights below freezing. More than two dozen people died in the cold last winter.
local.title: Mamdani says more help is coming to homeless New Yorkers living outside this winter

local.h: New York sends 20 Democrats and 6 Republicans to the House
local.b: Democrat Cait Conley flipped the Hudson Valley's 17th District by defeating Rep. Mike Lawler. Rep. Nicole Malliotakis remains the city's only Republican in Congress.
local.title: New York’s House delegation will include 20 Democrats and six Republicans

local.h: Woman dies after falling from moving SUV on the BQE
local.b: Police said the 37-year-old opened a rear door and fell out near the Brooklyn Bridge around 2:30 a.m. Sunday, then was struck by another car. No arrests have been made.
local.title: Brooklyn woman killed after tumbling from a moving SUV on the BQE near Brooklyn Bridge

goodnews.h: Jazz Age Lawn Party returns to Governors Island for a fall edition
goodnews.b: The Roaring '20s-inspired event marked its 21st anniversary with Charleston contests and live jazz from founder Michael Arenella's Dreamland Orchestra.
goodnews.title: Jazz Age fashions return to Governor’s Island for the Lawn Party's fall edition

goodnews.h: Brooklyn jogger killed in stabbing saves four lives through organ donation
goodnews.b: LiveOnNY said Katie Suarez's heart, liver, pancreas and kidneys went to four recipients ages 12 to 75.
goodnews.title: Brooklyn jogger killed in stabbing saves 4 lives through organ donations

goodnews.h: Mamdani expands free produce programs for SNAP recipients
goodnews.b: The city is adding funding to Health Bucks and Get the Good Stuff, which matches SNAP spending on fresh or frozen fruits, vegetables and beans dollar for dollar.
goodnews.title: Mamdani expands free produce programs for New Yorkers on SNAP

local.h: Judo champion Teddy Riner runs for French president
local.b: The Olympic star announced a 2027 bid, citing concern about the rise of the far right as Marine Le Pen leads the polls.

local.h: Teachers and students call strikes and protests for Tuesday
local.b: Education unions and student groups plan a nationwide mobilization on Nov. 10 with a major march in Paris, citing staffing and funding concerns.

local.h: France investigates whether foreign powers sent airline bomb threats
local.b: Paris prosecutors opened a probe into hoax bomb threats against dozens of flights in Europe over the past week. No explosives have been found.

local.h: France marks Armistice Day on Wednesday
local.b: Nov. 11 is a public holiday, with parades and wreaths at war memorials and the President laying a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at the Arc de Triomphe. Paris Photo opens Thursday.

local.h: Seattle School Board weighs legal action over trans sports ban
local.b: The board is poised to vote Monday on challenging Initiative 638, which 56% of Washington voters approved and which requires girls to prove their biological sex to play girls' sports.
